XY series · FLF

Flashfire

Released May 7, 2014 · 110 cards

Expanded

Flashfire is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the XY series, released in English on May 7, 2014. Its main set has 106 cards, plus 4 secret rares numbered beyond the set (110 in total). It includes 94 Pokémon, 16 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

35 illustrators worked on Flashfire. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (33), Masakazu Fukuda (5), PLANETA (5), Ryo Ueda (5), Akira Komayama (3), Eske Yoshinob (3), match (3), Naoki Saito (3).
